info.title: harness-wiki API
info.description: HTTP API for LLM-maintained wikis (the 'LLM Wiki' pattern): persistent, interlinked markdown knowledge bases that a model builds and keeps current from the sources you ingest. Each wiki is a folder ./harness-wiki/<slug>/ in the directory the server was started in. Ingest and lint run in the BACKGROUND (202); follow them with GET /api/wiki and the wiki's status. The API has no authentication: whoever can reach the port can make the server copy any file it can read into a wiki (sources are paths ON THE SERVER) and can spend the configured model's tokens — keep it on 127.0.0.1 unless the network is trusted.

get.description: Returns the harness-wiki version and process metadata. Also the liveness probe: it does no wiki or model work, so a server that cannot answer it is not going to complete anything heavier either.

Every wiki with its slug, description and live status: 'ready', 'busy' (an ingest, lint, create or delete is running: 'op' and 'since' say which and since when; queries never make a wiki busy) or 'incomplete' (an ingest or lint was interrupted and the wiki may be half updated; run a lint). The status is computed on every call, never stored.

200.description: The wikis, sorted by slug (an empty array when there are none)

post.description: Creates the wiki (folders, a base AGENTS.md schema, the index and log) and then has its maintainer adapt the schema to the description. If that adaptation fails the wiki still exists and is usable, so the answer is still 201. Nothing is created on disk until the first wiki.

400.description: Invalid slug, or a missing slug or description

409.description: A wiki with that slug already exists

delete.description: Removes the wiki ENTIRELY: its sources, its pages and its schema. It cannot be undone. A wiki an ingest, a lint or another delete is working on is busy and is refused.

409.description: The wiki is busy. 'details' carries slug, op, since and elapsed_seconds

post.description: Copies the sources, unchanged, into the wiki's raw/ folder and starts its maintainer, which integrates them into the pages. It answers 202 as soon as the sources are copied; the maintainer works in the BACKGROUND and the wiki is 'busy' until it finishes. 'sources' are paths ON THE SERVER: a file, a glob ('**' matches across directories) or a directory, which is copied with the directory included; symbolic links found inside a directory are skipped and reported. 'files' are inline sources, each stored as a file ('name' may be a path such as 'ctx/data.md'). The copy is all or nothing: a file that already exists in raw/ with DIFFERENT content refuses the whole ingest with 409 and the list of clashes, while an identical one is reported as already ingested.

202.description: Accepted: the sources are in raw/ and the maintainer is working

400.description: Invalid slug or body, nothing to ingest, a source that does not exist or matches nothing, an unsafe file name, or a limit exceeded

409.description: The wiki is busy (details: slug, op, since, elapsed_seconds), or a file already exists in raw/ with different content (details.conflicts lists them; nothing was copied)

413.description: The request body is too large

post.description: Has the maintainer health-check the wiki and repair it: contradictions, stale claims, orphan pages, concepts without a page, missing cross-references, broken links. 202 at once; the wiki is 'busy' until it finishes. Also the way to repair an 'incomplete' wiki. The body is optional.

409.description: The wiki is busy. 'details' carries slug, op, since and elapsed_seconds

post.description: The wiki's maintainer searches its index, reads the relevant pages and answers from them; a valuable answer may be filed back into the wiki as a new page. It is synchronous: the connection stays open until the answer arrives or the timeout passes. A query takes NO lock on the wiki, so any number can run at once and it is answered even while an ingest or a lint is working (the maintainer may then see pages that are still being updated); it is never refused as busy.

400.description: Invalid slug or body, or a missing or blank question

504.description: The maintainer did not answer within the timeout

post.description: The same operations as MCP tools — WikiList, WikiCreate, WikiDelete, WikiIngest, WikiQuery, WikiLint — for a harness or any MCP client: `"mcp": {"wiki": {"url": "http://<host>:<port>/mcp", "timeout": 600000}}`. Each request is ONE JSON-RPC 2.0 message (or a batch) answered with a single JSON reply; a notification gets 202 with no body. Stateless: no Mcp-Session-Id, no SSE; GET and DELETE are 405. Methods: initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call. A tool failure is a result with isError:true, not a JSON-RPC error. IMPORTANT: harness's MCP client applies the server's 'timeout' (default 5000 ms) to every call, so set a large one (600000 or more) or WikiQuery and WikiCreate will be cut off. Same trust as the REST API: no authentication.

schema.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 request, notification, or an array of them

200.description: A JSON-RPC response (or an array of them for a batch)

202.description: The message was a notification (or a batch of notifications): nothing to answer

413.description: The request body is too large

slug.description: Also the wiki's folder name: 1-64 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens

op.description: What is running (busy) or what was interrupted (incomplete). Omitted when ready

since.description: When that operation started. Omitted when ready

slug.description: 1-64 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen, and not a reserved Windows name (con, nul, com1...)

description.description: What the wiki is about; its maintainer adapts the wiki's schema to it

model.description: Optional 'provider/model' for this one run. Omitted, the server's --model is used, and without one the first model any active provider offers.

IngestWikiRequest.description: At least one of sources and files

sources.description: Paths on the SERVER: a file, a glob ('**' across directories) or a directory (copied whole, directory included)

files.description: Inline sources, each stored as a file in raw/

guidance.description: Optional: what to focus on; does not change the wiki's rules

model.description: Optional 'provider/model' for this one run. Omitted, the server's --model is used, and without one the first model any active provider offers.

name.description: Relative path under raw/, with '/' or '\\' separators; may create folders ('ctx/data.md'). No '..', no absolute paths, no drive letters, no Windows-reserved names or characters

model.description: Optional 'provider/model' for this one run. Omitted, the server's --model is used, and without one the first model any active provider offers.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the answer (default 300; the server caps it at 1800)

model.description: Optional 'provider/model' for this one run. Omitted, the server's --model is used, and without one the first model any active provider offers.

WikiAccepted.description: A background job was started. There is no result report: follow the job with GET /api/wiki and the wiki's status

ingested.description: Ingest only: files copied now, relative to raw/

already_ingested.description: Ingest only: files that already existed in raw/ with identical content, left alone

skipped.description: Ingest only: source files not copied, each with the reason (for example a symbolic link inside a directory)

cwd.description: The directory the server was started in — where ./harness-wiki/ lives

tags.name: wiki
tags.description: LLM-maintained wikis: create, list, delete, ingest sources, query and lint. Ingest and lint run in the background (202) and are followed through GET /api/wiki and each wiki's status

tags.name: mcp
tags.description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) endpoint exposing the wiki operations as tools
